typography_policy.resolution_rule: Resolve approved project/template minima before execution; absent authority uses versioned workflow typography tokens. Never silently lower a resolved minimum. Historical project minima are scoped, not global defaults. Record title/body/labels/footer separately and font substitutions.

layout_repetition.metric: Observed macro-composition family after human-auditable normalization, including all card variants as GENERIC_CARD_GRID; denominator all slides, appendix included; report dominant share and longest adjacent run. Also report section/role breakdown.

readiness_aggregation: Design readiness is separate from deck acceptance and production adoption. In validated/full runs any BLOCK failure => BLOCKED; required scientific/authorization evidence NOT_ASSESSED also blocks validation. Pending mandatory human approval => PARTIALLY_READY, never VALIDATED. Warnings require review but do not alone block. Only all hard checks plus signed human reviews can mark the process floor satisfied; existing assisted-use semantics remain separate.
